description: Lengthens or shortens polyphonic gates under voltage control; the number of channels on TRIGGER sets the number of output channels

params.text: Attenuverter for the CV input, -1 to +1, setting how far that input moves the gate length and in which direction
Sets the length added to the gate on every channel, reaching 1 second with the range set to FAST, 10 seconds at MED and 20 seconds at SLOW
Picks the full-scale gate length for every channel: FAST for up to 1 second, MED for up to 10 seconds, SLOW for up to 20 seconds
RETRIGGER holds each output channel high for as long as its input gate lasts plus the set length; ONE-SHOT holds it high for the set length alone. The setting covers every channel

inputs.text: Modulates the gate length, scaled by the CV knob; the voltage is read over a range of -10V to +10V, and a monophonic cable applies the same voltage to every channel
The polyphonic gate or trigger that starts each channel's output gate; over 2V counts as high, and the STATUS matrix shows which channels are high
A gate over 2V cuts that channel's output gate short and holds it low until the next rising edge at TRIGGER; a monophonic cable applies the reset to every channel

outputs.text: The modified gates, one channel for each channel on TRIGGER, 10V while high and 0V while low
A 1ms trigger at 10V on a channel each time that channel's output gate ends

notes: to shorten a gate, choose ONE-SHOT and a length shorter than the incoming gates
